description: This file implements cgroup memory management functions, including setting memory limits, retrieving memory statistics, and handling NUMA memory data for the 'memory' cgroup subsystem.

classes.name: MemoryGroup
classes.description: Represents the memory cgroup controller with methods to apply configurations, set resource limits, and retrieve statistics.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the cgroup controller, which is 'memory'.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the cgroup configuration to a specified path and process ID.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets memory and swap limits, soft limits, OOM control, and swappiness for the cgroup.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves memory statistics, including usage, cache, and NUMA page usage.
